steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Nngh...!
You reel backward, your gaze racing across his form, hunting for any gap in his movements.
When his blade sweeps toward your flank, it falters, just a fraction of a second, enough for you to throw your arm up and block.
Trap or not, you have no time to second-guess it.
Crimson light erupts through the gaps in your fingers, slamming into his blade as it descends.
The strike is deflected, the sword tip skidding wide, but Chengxiao holds his ground. He just watches you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Neither of us wants to actually hurt the other. So why are we wasting time?

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: We needn't, if you are willing to stand down.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stand down...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're telling me to stand down. But what about your own soul?

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: This is precisely the consequence of me breaking the rules.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Those who dwell in the Realm of Yang have no business meddling in the Void of Yin. Yet I spoke out. I provoked her. I allowed her to seize my coin, and in doing so, I revealed to her that a physical object can be used to anchor a soul. For that, I must pay the price.

steps.speaker: Copper Coin
steps.content: <b>Why did you stop?

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: I scared you back there, didn't I? Forgive me. I had to say what I said to buy enough time to get you out. Had you remained in contact with her any longer, I doubt you would have lasted much past that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's exactly why I can't just follow the rules of this place and stand here watching you...
You look at the face beneath his mask, knowing it will one day be buried by the weight of years.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...end up exactly like what I'm looking at right now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The way you are now... it's not just from losing part of your soul.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If that monster is created, you'll die here. You'll end up just like Lichen... trapped in Maria City, stuck somewhere between life and death.
He lets out a quiet laugh.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: If you already know how this ends from having seen the future, then there is even less reason to waste time here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...You knew it the whole time.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: I do not know who you truly are. I only know that you are not that child, for that child never possessed the power to bring Li Xianling into the Void of Yin.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: What I also know is this: time and again along this journey, you clutched that coin tightly in your palm, wishing for nothing more than to escape this world.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're right. Ever since I got to Maria City, all I've wanted is to get out.
Trapped inside a child's body, eroded by the Illusory Moon, drained of almost everything, you've reached the point where even your shackles feel like a cage.
What has Maria City, the Illusory Moon, this whispering presence in your head really done to you? Broken your flesh? Unraveled your sanity?
Or turned you into someone ruled by <color=#fb9259>fear</color>, too afraid to take another step?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And for that, I turned to things I don't even understand.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The world I come from doesn't have ghosts or gods. Everything I've seen along the way is all just creatures born of Mania.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But somehow I keep believing in them more and more... That they're something else. Beings that bridge heaven and earth, like Lichen says. That if I just listen, they'll show me the way.
Meeting his stare, you advance into the surge of Mania radiating from the sword. The sludge grips your feet, but you leave your mark with every step.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And while I did that, I watched the people around me sink deeper and deeper into this place, one by one...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Being trapped here forever, I can live with that. But doing nothing? That I can't accept.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I refuse to accept it.
[White flash + sound effect]
He pulls the sword free from the sludge, but this time it slides into its sheath. His face hardens, and he offers you no further words.
You take a step toward the entrance, then another. The blade's whistle, a sound that once steadied you and once terrified you, never comes.
And so you leave it all behind, the grieving cries sweeping you forward as you race toward the tunnel's end.
